exposure: Type of ART treatment (autologous vs heterologous)
cohort: The study included 430 nulliparous women with dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies conceived with assisted reproductive technologies.
finding: Nulliparous twin pregnancies conceived with ART in mothers >=40 years old did not show a significantly higher incidence of total preterm birth, though an increased rate of iatrogenic preterm birth <37 weeks was observed.
